clips.title: The story
paras: Shandris Feathermoon is the General of the Sentinel Army and, for ten thousand years, Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand. She now commands night elf military forces throughout Kalimdor from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle off the coast of Feralas.

Shandris Feathermoon is one of the oldest defenders of the night elves. For ten thousand years she has served at Tyrande Whisperwind's side as the high priestess's right hand among the Sentinels, through the long vigil that followed the Sundering.
Following the Great Sundering and the founding of the Sentinels, Shandris became an indispensable commander within the night elf military.

Today, General Feathermoon serves as the supreme field commander of the Sentinel army. Stationed on Sardor Isle, she oversees Feathermoon Stronghold, an imposing elven fortress that keeps watch over the primal wilds of Feralas. From this island outpost, she monitors the encroaching threats of savage gnolls, lingering Gordunni ogres, hate-fueled satyrs, and the expanding power of the Horde in southern Kalimdor.
